title: Home
intro: A player’s guide to the current Tama game.

title: Attention & good care
intro: The Care page tells you what your Tama needs. Clear the need to clear its alert.

title: Buttons & first steps
intro: Four buttons are all you need to care for your Tama.

title: Corner Shop
intro: Littlebug Town’s little shop. Four things on the shelf, a friendly clerk, and new stock three times a day.

title: Growing up
intro: From one egg to an elder, through the forms your care leads to.

title: Fishing
intro: Cast a line at Littlebug Town’s Pond. Hook a fish, reel it in and keep it. Now and then you might pull up a boot.

title: Meals & snacks
intro: Meals fill the hunger bar. Snacks lift happiness. Both add a little weight.

title: Items
intro: Things your Tama owns, and how to look through them. Food lives on the Meals & snacks page.

title: Library
intro: The shelves are in place. Their contents are still to come.

title: Littlebug Town
intro: A little town with room to grow. The Pond is open for fishing; the other destinations can’t be entered yet.

title: Mail
intro: Your Tama’s letterbox. The inbox is in place; letters are still to come.

title: Sickness & medicine
intro: Fix the care problem first, then help your Tama recover.

title: The menu map
intro: Ten icons surround the screen. The triangle on the right points to the selected list entry.

title: Points
intro: Win points by playing games, then spend them at the Corner Shop.

title: Settings
intro: Press A and D together to open Settings from the home screen or any menu.

title: Sleep & Lights Out
intro: Rest restores energy. Lights Out lets you put your Tama to bed or wake it up.

title: Stats & hearts
intro: Count the hearts and check in before a small need becomes a care mistake.

title: World
intro: Places your Tama can visit. Choose World from the menu to see them. The Corner Shop and the Pond are open; the other places are still to come.

title: Kutchipatchi
intro: A adult form in the Tama family.

title: Egg
intro: A egg form in the Tama family.

title: Babytchi
intro: A baby form in the Tama family.

title: Marutchi
intro: A child form in the Tama family.

title: Tamatchi
intro: A teen form in the Tama family.

title: Mametchi
intro: A adult form in the Tama family.

title: Maskutchi
intro: A adult form in the Tama family.

title: Bill
intro: A elder form in the Tama family.

title: Teapot
intro: A adult form in the Tama family.

title: Fork
intro: A adult form in the Tama family.

title: Makkapakka
intro: A adult form in the Tama family.

title: Teletubby
intro: A adult form in the Tama family.

title: Shark
intro: A adult form in the Tama family.

title: Meet the characters
intro: 13 characters, from a tiny egg to an elder. Explore each form’s traits and animations.

title: Jumping Rope
intro: Time your jumps so the rope passes beneath your character. The pace changes as your score increases.

title: Climb
intro: Your Tamagotchi stands on a cloud while another drifts back and forth above it. Jump at the right moment to land on it and climb higher.

title: Shape
intro: Shapes fall down two lanes. Change your shape with B until it matches, then throw it up the left or right lane to knock the falling shape out.

title: Flag
intro: Match the large flag cues by colour. Raise both flags for a double cue, and ignore small fake cues. Reversed positions do not change the colour controls.

title: Manhole
intro: Hearts, money bags and snakes fall towards four manholes, one for each button. Open a hole just as a treat arrives to catch it, but keep it shut when a snake is coming.

title: The games room
intro: Learn the controls, see the screens, and find your next challenge.
